concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a young azure EASTERN DRAGON hatchling with a long serpent body sitting on auspicious clouds, the first stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line, in the same view and pose as image 1, sitting upright on its clouds with the neck raised and the head held high, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 head with face; 2 small jade crown and white mane; 3 two horns and a whisker; 4 coiled serpent body; 5 two short legs; 6 tail with a white tuft; 7 auspicious clouds;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 head with face: a cute chunky eastern-dragon head of azure-teal scales with a small rounded muzzle and cream-yellow lips and chin, two big golden-amber eyes (one small catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a confident smirk with one small fang where the old mouth is; no bronze plate, no helmet.
2 small jade crown and white mane: a small pale turquoise-jade crown with a thin coral-gold rim sitting on the forehead where the bottom of the old crest is, and above and behind it a tall flowing white mane plume streaming up and back like the old crest; the grey dome becomes the back of the white mane fluffing out behind the top of the head; no helmet, no bronze, no spirals.
3 two horns and a whisker: two short coral-gold antler horns (deer-antler shape with two or three rounded tines), one where each old ear is and pointing the same way; the cheek spike becomes one long thin white whisker curling out to the viewer-left.
4 coiled serpent body: the long serpent body: azure-teal scales (a few simple scale arcs) with a cream-yellow belly stripe along the neck where the cyan stripe is; the back coil the same azure-teal; the bottom coil azure-teal with a cream-yellow belly band instead of the bronze band; no bronze, no patterns.
5 two short legs: two short stubby azure-teal dragon legs, the TOP ends joining the body, the feet at the BOTTOM ends with three short ivory claws each.
6 tail with a white tuft: an azure-teal dragon tail with a cream-yellow underside in the same U shape, its upturned viewer-left tip ending in a flowing white hair tuft like the mane, where the old crystal is; no crystal, no flame.
7 auspicious clouds: two auspicious clouds in the same places and about the same size: flat white cloud puffs made of rounded swirl curls (ruyi curls) with a turquoise-jade band along the edges and a few turquoise swirl lines; no cyan-blue fill.

ATTITUDE: a proud little dragon ready to fight: brows angled down, a confident smirk with one small fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: azure-teal blue scales (a clear blue leaning to teal, NOT green), a cream-yellow belly, a flowing white mane, coral-gold antler horns, long white whiskers, a small pale turquoise-jade crown with a coral-gold rim, big golden-amber eyes, white auspicious clouds with turquoise-jade edges. Few colours.

AVOID: a green body or green scales, sky-blue or cyan clouds, a bronze helmet or crest with carved spiral patterns, heavy bronze armor plates, a yellow flame-shaped crystal on the tail, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
